info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Cross Channel By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of transaction authorization information across multiple banking channels based on a specified parameter. By querying with 'param1', users can access detailed authorization data that supports various banking operations. Typical consumers include financial institutions and developers integrating cross-channel capabilities into their systems. This endpoint enhances transaction visibility and ensures compliance with multi-channel banking needs.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific transaction authorization using its unique identifier. It provides a comprehensive overview of the transaction status, amount, and related information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide necessary details for transaction authorization. It should include all required fields as specified in the schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the transaction authorization details.

GetCrossChannelByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the transaction authorization operation in a cross-channel context.
